baseline_models.focus_anchor: The negative imperative at word 2 governs the totalized oath-bearer and the final lowliness descriptor.
baseline_models.mechanism: Repeated swearing presents verbal assurance as a warrant for yielding, while weak standing and discernment make that warrant unfit to govern action.

activation_trace.role: Pliant yielding supplies the action explicitly withheld from the speaker.
Encompassing totality makes the warning apply across the whole class, not only one lapse.
Frequent oath-taking supplies the repeated verbal warrant that solicits trust.
Lowliness and weak discernment locate the defect in the warrant-bearer's judgment.

changed_reading.before: A bare ban on obeying a contemptible person who swears often.
changed_reading.after: A warning against converting repeated assurance into authority when the assurance-bearer lacks the judgment needed to direct conduct.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Word 2 can involve responsive agreement, word 4 can form binding attachment, and word 5 can mark a self put into ordinary use.
baseline_models.mechanism: The speaker's oaths can recruit the hearer into reciprocal agreement; agreement hardens into attachment, and attachment turns the hearer's agency into a repeatedly used service.

activation_trace.role: Mutual responsiveness recasts obedience as an agreement produced between two parties.
Alliance and attached pacting make the oath a device for binding the parties together.
Putting a thing or self into routine service supplies the endpoint of captured agency.

changed_reading.before: The hearer merely receives and executes a bad order.
changed_reading.after: The hearer is warned not to enter an oath-made relationship that converts negotiated agreement into attached service.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus inventories juxtapose loss of sharpness at word 3, cutting fluency at word 4, inner facilitation at word 2, and wear through use at word 5.
baseline_models.mechanism: The oath-bearer's tongue remains sharp while repetition dulls the hearer's discrimination and wears down resistance until the self makes compliance easy.

activation_trace.role: Weariness and dulled acuity supply the hearer's possible loss of discrimination under repetition.
A sharp fluent tongue supplies the speaker's asymmetrical persuasive edge.
The self making an act easy supplies the final internalization of the speaker's pressure.
Wear through repeated use supplies the process by which resistance becomes commonplace.

changed_reading.before: The totalizer at word 3 only quantifies the people covered by the ban.
changed_reading.after: As a secondary branch activation, repeated sharp assurances may dull the hearer and make surrender feel internally effortless.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated non-obedience command is immediately followed by a desired two-sided softening, so yielding is not only command execution but entry into a reciprocal accommodation bargain.

activation_trace.role: Mutual responsiveness lets the focus prohibition govern negotiated alignment as well as one-way obedience.
Binding attachment lets repeated oaths serve as the proposed bond of accommodation.
The earlier repeated prohibition fixes yielding as the action under immediate pressure.
Direct falsehood identifies the party seeking the prohibited yielding.
Two-sided soft accommodation supplies the exchange by which each side is invited to relax its stance.

structural_cues: The sequence repeats the non-obedience imperative, then places the desired concession and its reciprocal answer in one conditional movement.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated refusal, falsehood, and reciprocal accommodation; I infer that oath-backed persuasion brokers the exchange; live alternative: the oath-bearer may simply be one item in a vice list rather than the broker of the preceding bargain.

changed_reading.before: Do not carry out the habitual swearer's commands.
changed_reading.after: Do not enter the mutual smoothing process by which oath-backed assurances turn principled distance into reciprocal compromise.

context_deltas.mechanism: Compressed speech, mobile tale-bearing, and violent dragging make the oath-bearer a working enforcement node: reputation is pressed into language, carried between people, and converted into coercive movement.

activation_trace.role: Yielding is the behavioral result produced by the proposed enforcement workflow.
Cutting verbal fluency supplies the oath-bearer's instrument of pressure.
Practiced service permits a functional reading of the speaker as a skilled but degraded operative.
Pressure concentrated in speech supplies the first stage of reputational force.
Walking with malicious reports supplies mobility between social locations.
Speech exiting as a damaging report supplies the content that circulates.
Forceful dragging supplies the conversion of verbal pressure into coerced direction.

structural_cues: Successive intensive agent forms present recurrent operations rather than isolated accidents.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies pressured speech, mobile reporting, tale-bearing, and forceful dragging; I connect them as stages of one enforcement workflow; live alternative: they may remain separate character faults with no causal sequence.

changed_reading.before: The verse describes a personally unreliable and socially low speaker.
changed_reading.after: It can also warn against a practiced reputational enforcer whose oaths, circulating reports, and coercion make other people move.

context_deltas.mechanism: External capital and lineage coexist with the focus descriptor of lowliness, forcing the descriptor away from simple poverty and toward degraded judgment, use, or moral function.

activation_trace.role: Weakness in standing or discernment supplies an inward or functional lowliness rather than an economic category.
Possession and abundance of wealth block an equation between lowliness and material lack.
Lineage and descent add social extension and inherited standing to the external-status side of the paradox.

structural_cues: The wealth-and-sons clause follows the portrait as a reason-like or circumstance-like qualification.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies lowliness together with wealth and sons; I infer that the lowliness is not socioeconomic; live alternative: the later clause may explain rejection of signs without directly narrowing the earlier descriptor.

changed_reading.before: The prohibited figure is low because he lacks social or material standing.
changed_reading.after: He can possess wealth and lineage while remaining low through defective judgment and a degraded use of influence.

context_deltas.mechanism: An oath distributed across companions synchronizes a total plan, removes its exception, and establishes a boundary that keeps the dependent beneficiary outside.

activation_trace.role: Totality supplies the plan's pressure toward closure without remainder.
Pact and attached alliance supply the group-binding function of the oath.
Withholding the hand from giving supplies the social output toward which the coordinated plan moves.
An oath apportioned among its people supplies collective synchronization rather than private emphasis.
Removing an exception closes the plan against qualification or remainder.
Entry into an interior supplies the boundary whose crossing is denied to the beneficiary.

structural_cues: The garden sequence moves from group oath, to emphatic cutting, to no exception, whispered coordination, and a stated entry ban.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the ordered oath, exception failure, and exclusion; I infer that the oath coordinates the group and causes closure; live alternative: it may only voice a plan already formed rather than produce their solidarity.

changed_reading.before: Habitual swearing is an individual credibility defect.
changed_reading.after: Oath-taking can be a coordination technology that binds a group into a totalizing project of withholding and exclusion.

context_deltas.mechanism: Inscribed, ordered, and judgment-bearing warrants form one evidentiary pole; claimed enduring oaths and a self-appointed guarantor form a rival pole that tries to turn assertion into authority.

activation_trace.role: Yielding supplies the jurisdictional effect sought from the rival warrant.
A disputed matter that provokes opposed oaths supplies uncertainty disguised as sworn certainty.
The prepared writing instrument supplies durable inscription as an accountable mode of warrant.
Ordered written lines supply structured record rather than improvised insistence.
A written fixing that imposes judgment supplies the missing authorization tested by the question.
Sworn oaths supply the asserted replacement for documentary authorization.
Assumed guaranty supplies the person who claims to make the unsupported entitlement hold.

structural_cues: The surah opens with writing and ordered lines, later asks for a book, then tests claimed enduring oaths and a guarantor in sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies recurring writing, a judgment-bearing book, oaths, and guaranty; I infer an evidentiary contrast in which swearing counterfeits warrant; live alternative: written and sworn images may be parallel topics rather than deliberately opposed authorization systems.

changed_reading.before: The habitual swearer is untrustworthy because he talks too much.
changed_reading.after: He represents a counterfeit warrant system that substitutes repeated sworn force and personal guaranty for accountable authorization, then demands obedience as its ruling.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same root field moves from a present command not to yield to a later inability to perform when called; deliberate refusal while sound is therefore distinguished from incapacity after agency has closed.

activation_trace.role: Present pliant yielding is the voluntary response that the imperative tells the hearer to withhold.
Practical capacity makes present noncompliance an exercised choice rather than a failure of ability.
Later inability supplies the temporal reversal in which the requested response can no longer be enacted.
Prior soundness confirms an earlier interval in which responsive capacity was intact.

structural_cues: A negative imperative in the focus is answered later by negated ability, followed by recollection of earlier calls during soundness.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the same root field in chosen refusal and later incapacity plus prior soundness; I infer a temporal contrast in agency; live alternative: the later incapacity may illustrate judgment without implying that 68:10 preserves capacity.

changed_reading.before: Non-obedience is simply a negative response to a bad person.
changed_reading.after: Non-obedience here is a positive exercise of intact agency: refuse the false claimant while refusal is still a choice, before response itself becomes unavailable.

context_deltas.mechanism: Stepwise taking plus extended time activates the focus images of self-facilitation, dulling, and wear: repeated assurances can condition obedience gradually rather than secure it in one command.

activation_trace.role: Inner facilitation supplies the point at which external repetition becomes self-administered compliance.
Dulling through fatigue supplies the weakening of resistance over repeated exposures.
Wear by routine use supplies the degradation of agency into an available instrument.
Taking by successive degrees supplies the incremental shape of the conditioning process.
Extended time and respite supply the duration in which repeated pressure can become ordinary.

structural_cues: The focus uses intensive descriptions of recurrence, while the later pair explicitly joins degree-by-degree movement to temporal extension.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies stepwise taking and extended time in a divine-action passage; I transfer only the process shape to the focus speaker and infer habituation; live alternative: the agents and purposes differ too much for that analogy to govern the focus warning.

changed_reading.before: The oath-bearer asks once and the hearer either obeys or refuses.
changed_reading.after: Habitual swearing can work as slow conditioning, wearing down acuity until the hearer's own self makes each next concession easier.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This uses the non-dominant split mapping of the focus root, so it is a secondary spatial-acoustic image, not a morphology claim. It remains anchored at focus word 2 and is reinforced by sharp speech and mobile report-bearing; downstream prose should label it an exploratory propagation analogy.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The non-dominant mapped branch at word 2 can image rising spread, while word 4 can image a sharp tongue.

activation_trace.role: The non-dominant branch contributes a form-distant image of something rising and spreading through the air.
Sharp verbal fluency supplies the speech that seeks a medium of propagation.
Walking malicious reports supplies the social relay that carries speech onward.
A report that exits into circulation supplies the propagated content.

changed_reading.before: Obedience only changes the hearer's own behavior.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, obedience also makes the hearer a relay through which oath-laden speech rises, travels, and recruits further social force.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is a cross-domain material analogy rather than a claim that obedience literally means slipping. It remains anchored in mutual compliance and agency worn by use, while the context supplies coating and loss of footing; downstream prose should retain the language of 'as if' or 'can be imaged as.'
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Responsive agreement at word 2 and wear through use at word 5 allow obedience to be imaged as a stance made progressively easier to dislodge.

activation_trace.role: Mutual compliance supplies the relational stance that begins to give way.
Wear through repeated use supplies the progressive loss of resistant footing.
Oil or coating supplies the material image of accommodation smoothing the surface between positions.
Sliding from one's station on a surface without footing supplies the endpoint of repeated smoothing.

changed_reading.before: Accommodation is a harmless softening before a discrete decision to obey.
changed_reading.after: Accommodation can be imaged as lubrication: repeated oath-backed smoothing removes traction until the hearer slides from a held position into compliance.

strongest_changes: The warning expands from command refusal to refusal of reciprocal accommodation and oath-made attachment.
The garden sequence shows oath as collective coordination that closes exceptions and excludes a beneficiary.
Writing, book, enduring-oath, and guarantor cues expose habitual swearing as a counterfeit warrant system.
The later inability at 68:42 turns present non-obedience into an exercise of intact agency rather than mere negativity.
Wealth and lineage force the lowliness descriptor away from material poverty toward degraded judgment and use of influence.
summary.what_was_special: The focus inventories supported an unusual asymmetry between a sharp oath-bearing tongue and a hearer dulled through repetition. Context then activated social, legal, temporal, and material versions of the same capture process without collapsing them into one final reading.
remaining_uncertainties: The pact-and-service model is branch-grounded but not forced by the surface syntax.
The contrast between accountable inscription and sworn assertion is abductive rather than explicitly stated.
The incremental-wear model and both outliers depend on analogical transfer and should remain visibly qualified.
